what_happened: GHR 1994 Chapter 10 section 10.2 -- the exact ZTime separation section this task must formalize, Lemmas 10.2.1-10.2.8 and Theorem 10.2.9 -- is present IN FULL in the corpus at /home/benjamin/Projects/Literature/sources/gabbay_1994/ch1001_chapter-10-expressive-completeness-of-si.md, despite the literature briefing's chapter-10 entries advertising only sections 10.3.1 and 10.3.2. Full step map extractable without reading the PDF.

GHR94 Lemma 10.2.3's printed formula for Case 5 is refuted over integer time by an explicit counterexample (a(0), A(1), B identically false, q(1)=q(2); LHS true at t=3, RHS false since both printed disjuncts carry the conjunct [A or (B and U(A,B))] evaluated at t). Verified against the ch10 PDF text, not only the markdown chunk -- the PDF layout carries the same conjunct on the second disjunct, which also contradicts GHR's own gloss that the second disjunct covers the case where A is true in the PAST. A gloss-consistent reconstruction (dropping that conjunct from disjunct 2) survives the counterexample on that model. Implementation must RECONSTRUCT and independently verify Cases 5-8, not transcribe them.

Two major pre-existing assets found. (1) plusValidZTime_iff_plusValidInt (FormalSystem/PlusLanguage/PlusIntTransfer.lean, live and compiled) collapses the ZTime carrier quantifier to the single carrier Z, so the whole elimination layer can be proved over concrete integers rather than over an abstract successor-Archimedean ordered group. (2) An archived GHR 10.2 transcription of about 10,300 lines exists at Boneyard/Kamp/KampWeakCanonical/Separation/ (Eliminations.lean cases 1-4 worked, Hierarchy/ carrying junction_depth, count_U_subformulas, abstract_untl, subst roundtrip and an all_formulas_separable skeleton) -- unchecked (#exit, never compiled) but a usable architectural blueprint.

All seven pinned Lean Challenge Statements were compile-verified at plan time: lean-challenge-snapshot.sh --dry-run --compile assembled the Challenge module and reported 'compile: OK' against the repo toolchain, so every contract signature is known to type-check against the existing vocabulary before implementation starts.

The research report's illustrative USForm sketch indexes leaves by Fin n; the plan replaces it with an unparameterized USForm indexed by the natural numbers (Decision D-a), because GHR's fresh-atom abstraction/resubstitution steps would otherwise incur a Fin-cast obligation at every one of Lemmas 10.2.5-10.2.8. Recorded as a deliberate deviation from the report's sketch, not a correction of it.

The pre-commit typst-sync-check.sh --counts-only gate fires on every module-adding commit because typst/generated/status.typ pins FormalSystem file/line counts. Plan Phase 14 owns that file, but the gate forces the regeneration at each module-adding phase commit instead. Resolution: run scripts/typst-sync-check.sh --fix and stage typst/generated/status.typ in every module-adding phase commit; Phase 14 then only has to confirm, not re-derive.

Phase 5 DECISION GATE measured 1 of 4, not 4 of 4. A Case 5 candidate was derived from the semantics (split on the pure-future U(A,B)@t, rewrite U(A,B)@r as the re-anchored bad*(r), re-anchor the guard-failure condition at its rightmost witness) and survives all three probe models including the one that refutes GHR's printed formula; the six probe theorems compile. Cases 6, 7 and 8 yielded no pinned candidate: their guard-failure conditions are exists-forall over the window (s,t], whose re-anchoring retains an s-bounded forward conjunct with no analogue of Case 5's collapse, so the re-anchoring does not terminate at a fixed finite formula. Primary contingency branch of the plan taken: Phase 7 and the phases downstream close as COMPLETED WITH EXCLUSIONS; Phases 1-6 and 14-15 land.

Phases 1-4 landed first-try or near-first-try: Syntax.lean compiled on the first build, and the usTruth_swap_congr duality combinator reduced every past-side statement of GHR 10.2.1 and 10.2.2 to a single simpa line. Packaging the duality once, as the plan's Phase 3 directed, paid for itself immediately.
